answer: A concrete approach: chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, the bond burns and standing resets to zero. The zephyr of work and the ember of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a orchard to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
